Act 173 §5 struck the former home-mining noise limitation, data-center equal-treatment rule and discriminatory-rezoning provision, while retaining compliance with applicable zoning law; Act 174 §2 addresses the same subsection. Do not present the 2023 limitations as necessarily current. The mining business definition involves more than 1 MW average annual use.
